description: The closed vocabulary of StarCore UI contract v1.1 - see docs/ui-contract.md. The Engine (engine/starcore/ui_contract.py), Mission Control (mission_control/ui/contract.js) and the Android app (mobile/src/satellites/ui/contract.ts) each test that they implement exactly this list. 1.1 only adds to 1.0: every 1.0 document is a valid 1.1 document.

since._note: The minor each block, key or format arrived in. A document that declares an older minor may not use them.

1.2._note: {play: {search}}: the client searches the audio.library provider and plays the results through its media.audio host. A document using it requires client media.audio and capability audio.library. {own: section}: the client opens the Satellite's own interface (page.js, native screens) at a section that interface names; a client without one hides the control (a tile skips that entry of its media-grid `open`). {secure: {capability, operation}, item, confirm?, then?}: in a media viewer's or selection's actions, the client runs one of secure_operations on the items, behind its own unlock prompt (never a document form) - see secure_operations.

secure_operations._note: What the secure action (1.2) may run: a capability, and the operations of it a document may ask for. The client resolves the provider from the catalog, asks for the unlock in its own prompt (a single-use grant for exactly these items), and sends references to the document Satellite's own media.gallery items, built from `item` (a binding to each item's id). Only a Satellite that provides media.gallery may use it, on its own items.

operations.list: GET ?path=<absolute path, or empty for the roots> -> {path, parent, entries: [{name, type: dir|file, size, modified}]}; at the roots an entry's name is itself an absolute path

operations.resolve: GET /<id>?quality=&format= -> {track, plan, stream, gain}; stream is a path relative to the provider, answering Range requests

optional_operations.lyrics: GET /<id>?language= -> synced lines or plain text

audio.library._note: Track: {id, title, artist, album, album_id, duration, has_artwork, quality: {label, lossless, hires}}; providers may add keys. See docs/media-audio.md.

operations.list: GET ?kinds=image,video[&limit=N&cursor=C] -> {items: [{id, kind: image|video, title, duration, group}], next}: what a person may pick, newest first; with limit, a page and the cursor of the next (null at the end)

optional_operations.resolve: GET /<id> -> {id, kind}: an item the person may act on now (in the active library); 404 otherwise. What the Engine asks before another Satellite acts on a reference a client sent.

media.gallery._note: Picked through the client's media.picker (the pick action). A pick returns references, never paths: [{provider, capability, id, kind}], where provider is the providing Satellite's name. A provider lists only what the signed-in session may see; private or protected media is never listed.

operations.queue: GET ?device=&expand=1 -> {state: QueueState (+ tracks) | null}; POST {device, state, name, kind} saves it

optional_operations.history: POST {track_id, seconds, device, context} records a play
optional_operations.radio: GET /<track|artist|album|genre>/<id> -> {tracks: [Track]}, to continue when the queue ends
optional_operations.preferences: GET -> preferences; POST {key: value} -> preferences (streaming and download quality, effects, speed)
optional_operations.stream: GET /<id>?quality=&format= -> the audio, answering Range requests; used when resolve can't plan a stream
optional_operations.connect: StarCore Connect under this route: POST register, state, command, transfer; GET devices, events

audio.session._note: A provider's playback session beside its audio.library, from the same Satellite. QueueState: {tracks: [id], order, position, shuffle, repeat, seconds, context}. See docs/media-audio.md.

operations.status: GET -> {configured, pin_set, unlocked, expires_at, session_timeout_seconds, ...}: whether this session could move media in now, or must unlock first
operations.unlock: POST {pin, for?: {operation: "move_in", items: [reference]}} -> with for: {grant, expires_at}, a single-use grant for exactly that move, without unlocking the vault; without: {unlocked, expires_at}. Attempts are counted and locked out as for any unlock
operations.move_in: POST {items: [reference], grant?} -> {moved, failed}: moves media.gallery items into the vault, under this session's unlock or a matching grant; every reference is resolved on the server, again at the moment of the move

optional_operations.biometric: POST challenge {key_id} -> {challenge}; POST unlock {key_id, challenge, signature, for?} -> as unlock

media.vault._note: A protected store media can be moved into, by the client's own unlock prompt (the secure action). It offers no way to list or read what it holds: that stays in the providing Satellite's own interface. A reference is {provider, capability: "media.gallery", id}, and is only a claim: the server resolves it through the media.gallery provider it knows.

client_capabilities._note: Device features a client may offer a document beyond rendering blocks. media.audio (the shared audio host, docs/media-audio.md) is what the play action needs; the rest are reserved names no client claims yet. A document that requires one a client doesn't offer is shown as needing a newer app.
